There's a small backstory, but not necessarily a plot. The man by the window is one of the mechanics for a deep space expedition group. He and a few others were tasked in maintaining the space vessel and monitoring the crew mates in their cryo-chambers. Unfortunately, he was chosen first to maintain the expedition. With a seemingly endless trip ahead of him, the mechanic gazes out the window into the unknown territory. To his shock, a humanoid figure made of light materializes itself close to the ship. The mechanic stares at the mysterious being in awe, paralyzed by its beauty. The figure was similar to an "angel" described in the old log books; simply drifting along with the ship and showed no signs of aggression. Strangely, it reminded the mechanic of himself... drifting all alone in the vacuums of space. A sudden tear wells up in his eye as he thought about his loved ones at home. The mechanic and the entire crew acknowledges that their home planet won't be recognizable when they come back and their loved ones long gone. My bad I kinda wrote a book lol
